Ensure that lists are structured correctly
axeViolations.help: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements

axeViolations.description: Ensure interactive controls are not nested as they are not always announced by screen readers or can cause focus problems for assistive technologies
axeViolations.help: Interactive controls must not be nested
